name: ReUI
summary: Design-forward freemium shadcn/ui registry: 1,000+ free components plus custom free primitives; Pro blocks/icons gated.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free ReUI custom primitives (Base UI docs paths); 1,000+ free c-* examples and Pro blocks/icons/templates not ingested.
Freemium: Pro blocks, icons, and paid templates require license — excluded (proOnly false only).
Dual Base UI + Radix docs; catalog demos use /docs/components/base/{slug}.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Extended shadcn alert with success/info/warning/invert variants.

demo.peerNotes: Requires shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Free primitive via @reui registry (no license key). Base UI path used for demos; Radix twin at /docs/components/radix/{slug}.

components.copyCode:
# components.json registries: "@reui": "https://reui.io/r/{style}/{name}.json"
npx shadcn@latest add @reui/alert

import { Alert } from "@/components/reui/alert"

<Alert />

copyPrompt.text: Use ReUI free MIT React component `Alert` (slug `alert`) from https://reui.io/docs/components/base/alert. Freemium library — this primitive is free forever (not a Pro block). Setup: shadcn/ui + React + Tailwind, add registry `"@reui": "https://reui.io/r/{style}/{name}.json"`, then `npx shadcn@latest add @reui/alert` (copies source; Base UI and Radix variants available under /docs/components/base|radix/alert). Home: https://reui.io. Docs: https://reui.io/docs/installation. Repo: https://github.com/keenthemes/reui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keenthemes/reui/main/LICENSE.md; Copyright (c) 2025 Keenthemes Inc). Pricing freemium — free comps/primitives only; Pro blocks/icons/templates excluded.
